title: UFO files detail 'skinwalkers' seen at famous US paranormal hotspot
excerpt: The Pentagon released a new batch of declassified UFO documents on Friday, including an investigation into mysterious portals and creatures near America's famous paranormal hotspot.
content:
The Pentagon released a new batch of declassified UFO documents on Friday, including an investigation into mysterious creatures roaming near a Utah ranch.

The 2010 report details residents’ claims of encounters with ‘skinwalkers,’ including a dog-like figure with a human-looking nose, alongside towering shadows and unexplained lights. 

In Navajo tradition, a skinwalker is a malevolent witch said to be capable of taking animal form.

One man described a hunched creature he estimated was six feet tall and weighed about 250 pounds during an encounter in January 2010.

‘The head was described as looking like a German shepherd dog without the pointed nose,’ the report states. ‘The nose was described to be more similar to a human nose.’

The accounts also include loud howling outside homes, with one witness claiming a supposed skinwalker’s cries caused surrounding coyotes to howl in response.

Other accounts in the newly declassified reports include a portal appearing near a lake, which she said was 'a doorway to another world.'

They were collected by Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies (BAASS), whose personnel visited the Fort Duchesne area in March and April 2010.

Although identifying details are heavily redacted, its map places the investigation around Skinwalker Ranch, a 512-acre property in Utah’s Uintah Basin associated with reports of paranormal activity

The man who described the January encounter said light falling on the figure revealed short black fur mixed with gray, pointed ears and a short tail.

‘It ran like it was leaping,’ investigators recorded.

He also claimed its howl warned people that it was passing through.

The same witness reported another encounter two nights before his March 24 interview.

He said he was inside his home around 8pm when a large shadow raced past the front of the house.

His dogs began barking and chased what he believed was a skinwalker, which he said repeatedly struck a barbed-wire fence.

The man said it moved ‘like a track star’ before fleeing toward an abandoned farmhouse across the road.

The witness in January said the creature ran into his fence, leaving behind fur that investigators tested

He remained indoors during the roughly 30-minute episode, watching from his doorway.

Investigators searched the fence and recovered fur caught on a barb, which they submitted for laboratory analysis.

The findings pointed to an ordinary explanation for the material collected.

Two unidentified fence samples shared the same canine DNA sequence as a control sample taken from a dog on the property.

BAASS said the matching results, similar appearance of the hairs and freely roaming dogs strongly suggested they came from the same animal, although the DNA match alone was not definitive.

A woman also recalled seeing what she believed was a ‘portal’ roughly 20 years before her 2010 interview.

She described a clear, stationary formation about 30 to 40 feet high that rippled like water and resembled a heat shimmer, which she observed from approximately 100 feet away.

The woman said it gave her a peaceful feeling and remained visible when she left.

She told investigators she came to interpret it as a doorway to another world after reading a ‘Skinwalker’ book.

Other interviews concerned different figures, which were not all explicitly identified as skinwalkers.

Witnesses describing the towering shadows said they had heard a ‘growling roar’ outside their home around 11pm on March 22, 2010.

The sound occurred twice, lasting roughly five to 10 seconds each time, according to their account.

BAASS said the matching results, similar appearance of the hairs and freely roaming dogs strongly suggested they came from the same animal, although the DNA match alone was not definitive

Another man recalled a three-foot-long, hairy arm reaching through his bedroom window in winter 2003.

He described four long fingers, no visible thumb and dog-like nails, saying the arm withdrew when he shouted.

A young woman described a hunched, female-looking figure with shoulder-length black hair and ragged clothing jumping between rooftops around 2009.

She said her mother also saw it and called 911, prompting a police response.

The witness identified the figure as what she said was known in Ute culture as the ‘Basket Lady.’

A separate woman reported an eight-foot, hairless creature crouched on a horse shelter in September 2009 before leaping away.

She acknowledged seeing it only briefly from behind. Her four-year-old daughter reportedly compared it to a kangaroo.

The report also records accounts of mysterious balls of light.

One witness described a blue orb hovering near Bottle Hollow Lake before moving toward Skinwalker Ridge.

Another woman recalled seeing a small aqua-blue light hovering in a tree outside her home in February 2010.

It disappeared ‘in the blink of an eye,’ she said.

She described it as dim and said it did not illuminate the tree.

Another account described floating lights that appeared to move behind objects when a witness’s presence was noticed, a behavior he interpreted as an attempt to hide.

Investigators installed motion-triggered cameras and continued gathering testimony, but the report does not establish that the figures were supernatural or determine what caused the lights.
